title: Launcher search field: glyph, border, tokens, and text baseline
description:
Design audit raised 2026-09-06, against the Noctalia launcher as reference.

Four defects in one control, all in paintTextField:

1. Typed text sits against the top edge of the well instead of on its midline. paintText draws from the top of the box it is given; invisible while a field was only as tall as its text, obvious now the field is a 56px pill.
2. The magnifier was built from a filled square with a smaller square punched out in the well colour, plus a staircase of 3x3 blocks for the handle. It cannot antialias, and the punch-out assumes a flat well behind it. It also sat 13px from the left edge, inside the curve of the stadium cap, so it read as crowding the corner.
3. The border did not render crisply. It was drawn as a fill of the border colour with a smaller fill laid on top, so the border was the arithmetic difference of two silhouettes quantised to whole pixels, which thins and breaks up around the corners. The same construction was used for the panel's own rim.
4. The field stroked Rim, which is the floating panel's edge token. The field and the panel it sits on drew the same colour, so neither read as deliberate. A field is a control and should carry Outline.

WORK IN PROGRESS on feature/launcher-ui-parity: added RingMask and SearchGlyphMask as antialiased cached masks, routed strokeRoundedRect and the panel rim through the ring, moved the field to Outline, gave the focused field the existing 2px accent focus ring, and added centreLine. Four render tests still need updating to the new geometry.
